actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Deafened apply=false] conditions until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.

actions.name: lightning storm
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=YVri6iuieFUUiO1d]], each creature in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=YVri6iuieFUUiO1d]]-foot-radius, [[lookup @target.template.height activity=YVri6iuieFUUiO1d]]-feet-high Cylinder originating from a point the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=YVri6iuieFUUiO1d]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.
